purpose: Machine-readable list of behavioral requirements for the fresh-agent queue.

scenarios.requirement: A consumer cannot start until a fresh validator has verified every material dependency.
Unknown, self-referential, and cyclic dependency graphs are rejected before dispatch.
Active work never exceeds the declared concurrency limit.
An agent identifier is used for exactly one queue attempt across the ledger.
Every worker dispatch uses fork_turns none and records a subagent role.
Concurrent items cannot have equal, ancestor, or descendant write scopes.
Failures consume attempts and exhaustion blocks the item and its dependents.
A validator is fresh and cannot be the producer of the artifact it validates.
A failed validation item is terminal even with attempts remaining; a fresh approved repair item must complete before a distinct fresh validation item can start.
No item can pass without non-empty acceptance evidence.
An item marked as approval-requiring cannot start until its approval key is recorded.
Substantive queue items cannot be assigned to the orchestrator or any non-subagent actor.
Status output contains queue facts and evidence, not worker reasoning transcripts.
